label: For "Wafer Yield Excursion Detection": Detect and attribute yield excursions in semiconductor or electronics fabs to a tool, step or lot from inline metrology and fault data, so engineers contain them within hours. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Lot-level averages.
